capsuleTopic.title: Abraham
capsuleTopic.subtitle: Call · land · household · covenant · sons · testing · burial · memory
capsuleTopic.orientation: Do not reduce Abraham to one virtue, failure, promise, or later argument. Follow his relationships, movements, decisions, questions, losses, and later Scripture memory as they accumulate.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Follow Abraham from family origin and departure through land, household fracture, intercession, testing, burial, succession, and later Scripture’s varied uses of his memory.
